outcomes.summary: one-state/action r=1/2, gamma=0: five Bellman inputs map to 1/2, direct 128-term return is 1/2, zero contraction and greedy attainment agree; bounded fixture only

deterministic m=1 empirical reward and transition errors are zero (3 positive tolerances); 120 supplementary Bernoulli paths evaluated directly; fixed finite sample checks only, no adaptive uniform-time claim
12 one-state/action deterministic perturbations: direct discounted paths agree with the bound, including original gamma=0 equality for four alpha values; finite fixtures only
already-known optimal one-action controller: 153 explicit gamma-zero transitions, zero updates/escapes and zero 1/2-bad times; H=1, M=153; finite fixture, not the general escape theorem
18 deterministic one-state RMAX runs, r=0,1/2,1 and m=1,2,5: sample means, transition frequencies, first rebuild and exact known-model value checked; no general high-probability claim
m=1, epsilon1=1/4: actual delayed batch lowers b from1 to1/4, next action is a; one update despite both initial slacks zero, bounded by G=2 (outside visits1<=4); finite algorithm witness only

one-state all-one deterministic RMAX: batch of m=9365327 reduced by exact repeated addition, pre/post model values1 and zero bad actions; independent ceiling inequalities give finite H=1,M=599381145; bounded fixture only, no general PAC proof
zero-slack S=1,A=2 deterministic delayed-Q: 4640 simulated actions, m=2319 bad b-actions then fixed greedy a, one update and G=2; additive term positive, finite H=1,M=593945; bounded fixture only
3 explicit schedules n=1,2,4: n+1 bad actions and a later bad action after a good one; original n=1 values0,1,0 give exactly times1,3; no permanent-stopping inference

m=1 inadmissible U=(0,0): eight exact RMAX actions all choose zero-reward b, first rebuild leaves tied zero table and known set{b}; optimal reward1 exceeds U(a); finite replay plus fixed-state check only
m=1, epsilon1=1/4: actual delayed batch lowers b from1 to1/4, next action is a; one update despite both initial slacks zero, bounded by G=2 (outside visits1<=4); finite algorithm witness only
